review: To be honest, once you play this arrow game for a while, it is very enjoyable. You don't forget how to play. It makes you think more positive and alert, and when you clear a tough board, it feels so rewarding.

I really enjoy this game. With no time limit and the ability to stop when needed, I'm able to play when I have down time without worry of losing because I had to close out. The puzzles keep your mind working and it's a great way to relax.

This game is THE GAME. I can't put this thing down fr. Ads are minimal, difficulty level is just right. A small thing I love is that the arrows don't do damage if you release two intersecting ones at the same time. Every level is solvable and there's no evil timer.

I really really like this game. It's one of the only mobile games that I've been able to keep playing consistently for more than a month. The levels can take a bit to complete, so it's reasonable. There also isn't a bunch of in-game purchases like most mobile games who just want your money. I really recommend it :)

I find the CarEscape-type games get boring quickly, so I tried this one, which is a similar concept but more challenging. I like the simpler UI as well! Short ads and you can watch an ad for a hint if needed. Very fun!
Giving 5 stars for the simplistic yet challenging levels and the ads. Thank you for short ads that are quickly and easily skippable after a few seconds. It's a super fun game!

You know how some things are cathartic 🧘🏽, well that is how this game is for me. I love how relaxing it is, while still being able to keep my mind working. This game constantly keeps my problem-solving and critical-thinking skills sharp 🤓.

Honestly, out of all the arrow games I've played, this one is the best. The daily challenges are a decent level of challenge and take between 3 to 5 minutes. No timer, no energy meters, and no items needed to progress. Big thumbs up, the balance is good.
Pretty fun game with multiple difficulty levels of challenges. The gameplay is engaging, smooth, and perfect for unwinding after a long day.
Great game for killing time. I've gotten way more than my money's worth of entertainment out of it. The puzzles are clever and addictive.

This is soo much fun!! It took me awhile before I could clear the board, but the more I played it the easier it became to spot the openings for the arrows to go through. It's really satisfying once you get the hang of it!

This game is by far the best in terms of no forced ads in between the levels. Puzzles are clean, User Interface is simple and intuitive. It also has Dark Mode for us folks that can't tolerate bright lights.

I love this game. I'm so addicted that now it is just about the only game I play. It is hard for me to put it down. It has different levels of difficulty that make you think and trace every single arrow to find one to remove.

I love this game! Very addictive to play. The arrow puzzles vary in complexity and the challenges are fun to participate in. If you fail, you get a chance to continue where you left off instead of starting over. Nice feature. All in all, fun game to play.

I've played most of the Arrows games on the Play Store and this is the only one that's any good. It's simple, not flashy, respects your time, the challenges are the most fun part, and there's no gimmicks. It's the only game I'll open up and genuinely enjoy playing.

Simple concept, easy to learn and be good at. There are a bunch of similar games, but I like this one the best. There is nothing flashy about this game, you can put it on dark mode so you can play in bed at night without blinding yourself, and the ads are extremely tolerable.

The art direction is sleek, minimalist, and easy on the eyes. The gameplay is simple and easy to understand, but still requires thought and reflection, keeping the puzzles engaging. Thanks devs, it's a real gem!

Playing the game was a fun and rewarding experience. I enjoyed the engaging gameplay, smooth controls, and exciting challenges. It helped improve my problem-solving skills, concentration, and quick decision-making. Overall, it was entertaining, educational, and a great way to relax.

This is an excellent arrows game. As long as you take your time and pay attention, you can win. Interesting challenges with the different shapes, and it's truly skill. You can ALWAYS beat the level. Excellent game.

This is a surprisingly good app. It plays well and is nicely challenging, and the aesthetic is super clean and minimal and relaxing. Like, even the font is relaxing. Also, it has a native dark mode (thank you devs!). I think I'll be sticking with this one.

This is one of my favorite games. Every time I press an arrow, it works smoothly, without annoying hesitation. I downloaded 6 or 7 different arrow games trying to find this one. None of them work as well. After dealing with all those horrible clones, I'm so happy I found the real one.

Absolutely love this app, just done over 1000 levels, and I'm still hooked. It's a joy to play, you're not playing against the clock, there are mixed difficulty in levels and it keeps your mind active. Perfect if you want to switch off and relax for a while.

Challenging puzzles without intrusive ads! I don't even need WiFi to play, so this game comes in handy when I'm on a subway or traveling and can't play anything else. The daily Challenge Levels are bigger and more complex, and it's great that you can go back to previous months. Overall, relaxing, challenging, and fun.
I had just downloaded this and I'm loving it. The mechanics are crisp and responsive. It really helps you slow down and focus.

I am absolutely obsessed with this game. It's great for coordination between my eyes and my hands, and keeps my brain active. If you're looking for something to keep you busy or to burn time, this is absolutely the game for you.

I love this game. It's easy, it's not overly packed with ads, and it's a lot of fun. I would recommend this game to anyone who wanted something that was simple and fun. We have a lot of fun comparing our stages and progress.

I thought this was going to be boring but it is very addictive and a lot of fun! It exercises your brain and you actually feel more alert and alive after playing quite a few levels. Great game, good job to the developers!

Addictive! I find myself playing often. It's great to pass the time, especially if you only have a few minutes and don't want to doomscroll. I appreciate how you can go back to where you were if you need to stop mid-game.
Love the difficulties in the games. Easy to hard, ever changing. The puzzles are engaging and satisfying to clear!

I like this game of skill and accuracy, it's pretty addictive! You will start thinking it's easy, then all of a sudden the difficulty ramps up and makes you think through every move. Love this type of challenge.

I really like this game. I actually laugh out loud when I get stumped by a very short arrow! I don't mind the few times ads pop up so that I can continue playing. I really appreciate that I am not expected to buy anything to continue!
Fun, pleasing to the brain. Smooth animations, clean graphics, and relaxing gameplay.
I love this game, it's simple, clean, and the right challenge level. The ads don't interrupt my playing. Very clean compared to other games.
This is the only game I've ever reviewed. This game is amazing, a great mixture of relaxing puzzles & challenging ones. Ads only appear after you finish or if you lose lives. Infinity stars.
One of the best puzzle games I've played. If you know how to solve these puzzles fast, you can breeze through level after level in a matter of seconds. Love it!
Finally a game you can play and just win. Great time passer, fun, fast, manageable ads. Thank you for doing what so many other games haven't figured out!

Amazing brain training game! The arrow puzzles are simple to understand but become really challenging as you progress. It improves focus, logical thinking, and observation skills while being fun to play. The minimal design is clean, and the levels keep me engaged. Play in Dark Mode! Highly recommended! 🧠🎯

Great for when your mind won’t stop overthinking and you just need something else to focus on. It gives your brain something challenging to work hard at, which can be a really nice break from stressful or racing thoughts. Sometimes you just need to give your brain a different problem to solve, and this does exactly that! 10/10

This is a great puzzle game. If you just want a puzzle a day to make the brain quiet, the daily challenge is perfect. The app doesn't force unskippable ads or require you to pay for basic functions like line projections. Happy to support the app.

Surprisingly addictive (in a good way) for such a simple game. And levels do get more challenging too. It really keeps your mind busy, perfect distraction when doing night shifts and there's nothing to do.

I consistently play this game every night to help me fall asleep (sounds weird I know) but it works! It's calming and relaxing. I've been going through and completing every challenge level and it's a lot of fun.

This game is pretty good for your mind when you are stuck in chaos around you and want to spend some time and have some peace. Your concentration will increase and I like the way they increase the difficulty level by level.

Simple, fun, and forces you to think rather than just spam buttons. Does not make you pay for anything and lets you keep going in your current stage even if all your hearts run out. No stress, just a calm way to stimulate your brain.

I love this game! I might even be addicted, but the best part is not having all the ads interrupting you. As for the game, it's quick moving and allows the player to move at their own pace. And finally, no technical problems have happened, so this game is a win-win in my book!
Whether you're just trying to pass a little bit of time or get your stress level down, this is one of those must-have games. It's been a fantastic option for me.
It keeps a smile on my face when I run into a tricky board. Smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and very satisfying to clear.
Very simple game to play. Very sleek aesthetics and keeps me on my toes. Great for a mind wanting to see how fast you can figure it out.
Fun and addictive game! Even the clicking noise when you select an arrow is satisfying. Levels are well balanced and rewarding.
This game has no timer, has nothing that rushes you to finish. But it is challenging in every level, and I enjoy games like this. Bottom line, I love the game.
This app is really laid back, so it lets you relax and enjoy the game without putting a bunch of clutter all over your screen. Minimalist and clean.
This game is addictively fun with no timers. A great trade-off between keeping the game free and having challenging puzzles without intrusive paywalls.

Really love the 'simplicity' of the game. The mechanics, sound, and effects are perfect (minimal and not too grandiose so you can focus on the game). I especially enjoy the everyday challenges and I'm glad we can go back and do past days' challenges.
This one gets your brain working, it's an amazing puzzle game. You have to keep paying attention to each move. Great daily puzzles.
This game is fun and challenging. You don't have to watch an ad in between every single level, and the puzzles make you think carefully about each step.
Good game as promised. Great to just zone out, complex enough, but never unplayable. Just pure puzzle solving and minding your own business!

If you like simple design and visual puzzles that are a good balance of fun and challenging, then this game is for you. No flashing/neon colored graphics or odd animations. It's the perfect puzzle game if you're looking to relax and still feel like you're using your brain!
I'm an avid puzzle solver. Even though it's not an impossible brain teaser, it pulled me right in. I thoroughly have fun figuring out which arrow to release next. Relaxing, rewarding, and fun.

I'm really pleased with this game. I love the arrow games where I can just zone out and relax, but what I like the most about this game is how clean and well-made it is compared to all the other ones.
This game is NOT timed, which I love. You can zoom in and use a grid view when you aren't certain the way is clear. I have no complaints with this one.
I love this game. It relaxes me. I try every time for perfect play. I am now going back to complete all the daily challenges from earlier months.

Simple, straightforward, and incredibly satisfying. The controls are responsive and forgiving, and gameplay is remarkably smooth. You get plenty of lives, and best of all, ads never interrupt gameplay. You did a great job and should be proud of what you've made!
It's a mix of different challenge levels as you progress. You can pause at any time and pick up again at your convenience. It's kind of like figuring out different mazes. Fun to play while waiting.
Love the challenge of this game! The puzzles are clever and require spatial awareness. It's a great brain workout.

Very fabulous game. If you're bored and want something to kill some time, then go for it, you'll not regret installing this game. It'll improve your focus and observation skills. Overall a great package.
I'm sooooo addicted to this arrow game! The levels can be challenging but not so much that I get frustrated and give up. Smooth and fun.

Finally. A puzzle game that isn't doing too much. No constant popups for things to buy. No adding dozens of unnecessary mechanics that take away from the game. Simple graphics, good mechanics, just for the love of doing puzzles.
Doesn't heat up my phone like a lot of other games, and no time limits forcing you to rush for a puzzle. Can even go back and play older challenge levels which is great. Good job devs!
Pretty fun simple game. Great way to pass the time and keep your logic reasoning fresh.
After playing for a few days, I find this game really is a great game. It can be relaxing yet it can push your mind as well! Excellent game!
Fun game that keeps you on your toes! Great for those wait times on phone calls, in waiting rooms, or just to keep your brain working! Very fun!

I enjoy playing this game. It has fewer ads than most other arrow puzzle games, which makes the experience much more enjoyable. The gameplay is fun, smooth, and relaxing. I would definitely recommend it.

This game genuinely lets you relax and unwind. It’s very entertaining and has the perfect balance between keeping your brain active and being lighthearted. The interface is clean and smooth. Every touch feels precise. You can enjoy playing at your own pace.
The levels are fun and not too difficult. I love playing the game. Clean design and smooth mechanics.

I love this Arrows game. No waiting through an ad when you finish your game, no ad every time you start a game. They actually thought of the player when they made this game. A big thank you for a thoughtful play environment.
Love getting into the flow and it helps me unwind in an evening. Having access to all the previous challenges is brilliant. The normal levels are great as well.
Great game, ads are minimal. Makes you really contemplate your moves and strategy. Fun, relaxing, and very addictive once you get into it. The challenges are fun as well.
Great game that doesn't charge you for anything. I like playing a few minutes a day. It is somehow relaxing. Maybe it's because it isn't comparing you to other players, just your own pace.
Arrows is so awesome! So much fun. Great for keeping your mind calm with no timer - love that! It's like taking an adventure and finding out how it ends. Almost like you're planning an escape.

I really enjoy this game. The game is simple, you just touch the arrows to get them out of the puzzle but be careful not to hit other arrows. It's simple, can be challenging, and overall a decent way to kill some time or help unwind.

Incredible. I love this game so much. I never seem to get bored playing Arrows. It runs smoothly, each level is a different arrow puzzle, and the randomized difficulty keeps the game enjoyable. Highly recommend.

I like playing this game. Thankfully there are no adverts every few minutes. The patterns are good and the skill level is not too hard that you get stuck. I really like the daily challenges as they are bigger puzzles and take a few minutes longer to solve.
Simple, clean puzzle game. Easy, medium, and hard levels. Great game for the plane or to pass the time.
Simple, clean interface, is easy to learn, minimal adverts, and the dark screen is ace for my midnight baby feedings! Love it.
I absolutely love this puzzle game. Although it is very addictive, it is also very relaxing. No intrusive ads while in the game.
Very chill puzzle game. It's worth it to not get interrupted every few seconds. Good puzzles and clean presentation.
Simple puzzle, simple concepts, you can play it online or offline. A great brain workout.
It's a fun relaxing game. Challenging at times, and simply methodical at other times. Smooth and rewarding.
I really like this game. There is no time pressure. You remove each line that's not blocked by another, so you clear the board. Seems simple at first but gets complicated fast. Very addictive.
There's no timers, take it at your own pace which is nice. It's a fun way to pass the time.
The interface is very simple, which is the charm of this game. I like to relax and rewind in this game without having to watch 30 seconds of unskippable ads. Clean and peaceful.
Arrow Game is fun, challenging, and easy to play. The controls are smooth, the gameplay is addictive, and each level keeps you engaged. A great game for anyone who enjoys testing their spatial logic!
This is the simplest yet most fluent type of this genre of game. Smooth transitions and responsive touch detection.
Extremely addicting... I play it to relax. I love playing the challenges every month. Highly recommend to anyone looking for the best arrow game to download this one.
The levels alternate in difficulty making it extremely enjoyable to play for as long as you might desire. Very engaging and a fun time.
Peaceful play with minimal interruptions. It's fun and offers a nice variety of level difficulties to keep your interest. Definitely worth playing.
Nightmare levels are a fun challenge! This game makes you feel smart when you ease through the levels. Hats off to the team that had the brains to come up with such an impressive experience.
This game is so good and best for passing time. The grid function is great. Daily streaks are fun, and the theme is very clean and aesthetic. Very easy to use.
While it seems simple, it requires that one pays attention to all points of the puzzle to avoid making a mistake. Helps to develop not only one's focus but also helps improve concentration.
Simple, relaxing, and enjoyable. Helps me focus my mind in a nice, peaceful manner. The tactile feedback is so satisfying.
Greatest puzzle game I've ever played! I get lost in it and lose track of time till I've gone hours just solving these puzzles. Highly recommend to anybody who loves puzzles.
A great way to keep your strategy muscles sharp and in use, also good for hand-eye coordination. I very much enjoy the daily challenges as well.
It's a relaxing game, I don't get interrupted when I'm playing so I can go through 10 levels at a time which is amazing. There are not many games that do that. This is my favorite puzzle game.
I really enjoy playing this game. You have to be strategic in your moves to be able to finish the level. Keeps you hooked!
It takes seconds to learn, minutes to master and yet I find this game oddly compelling. In short it's well made, good fun and a great time killer.

It's such a soothing game. I play in dark mode close to bedtime because it helps my brain relax and focus on arrows instead of everything else. It is a perfect wind-down game and not over-stimulating.
